name: net_lod_party_row
description: VUH-2342: the host's story party row follows the host into the friend's next load. The host's LoD row is set to Donald + Goofy (0x12020100, a test-only write standing in for Ping's forced party menu); the friend's stays the save's Sora-only row. The host enters 08/00; the friend's row must become the host's before its load, and both games must build Donald and Goofy.

steps.expr: all((bridge(i).get('puppet0') or {}).get('active') for i in range(2))

steps.name: 1 The host's LoD party row changes (as Ping's forced menu does); the friend's does not

steps.message: the test-only host row write did not take, or the friend already had that row

steps.name: 2 The host enters LoD 08/00; the friend loads with the host's row and companions

steps.expr: [location(0), location(1), [peek(0x9ACE04,'u32',i) for i in range(2)], [[peek(0x2A25300+2*k,'u16',i) for k in range(4)] for i in range(2)], [sorted(a['name'] for a in actors(i) if a['name'][:2] in ('P_','N_') or a['name'].startswith('F_MU1')) for i in range(2)]]

steps.message: the friend's LoD row did not follow the host's

steps.expr: all(any(n=='P_EX020' for n in saved['after'][4][i]) and any(n=='P_EX030' for n in saved['after'][4][i]) for i in range(2))
steps.message: Donald and Goofy are not in both games
